about: FIXED pipeline (work/fiabiliser-analyse-ia): the production reader and analysis via runHandwritingCopy, on every fictitious handwritten copy. 'pdf' = what the browser sends (photos assembled into a PDF); 'images' = the same photos sent as images, on the legibility series only, to compare. No harness-level retry: the production client's own bounded retries are measured. Stops at the first exhausted-credit answer.
